institution: IIIT Kalyani (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Kalyani)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: One review cited ~92% on-campus placement rate in a recent phase (64 of 70 registered students placed); average package around 10.22 LPA and highest 15 LPA for that cohort; considered among stronger-placement IIITs in some comparative rankings alongside IIIT Agartala and IIIT Dharwad.
Classrooms equipped with digital boards, projectors, and air conditioning; individual bench/table seating noted positively.
Faculty members described as highly qualified; curriculum aligned with industry standards and structured to allow time for projects.
Multiple national and state-level scholarships available to help offset otherwise high fees.

key_negative_themes.notes: As a relatively new institute, IIIT Kalyani lacks its own permanent campus; classes run from WEBEL IT Park, Kalyani; permanent campus (around 50 acres) still under construction.
Lowest-rated category (2.5/5); total course fees around 12 lakh (some reports ~11 lakh including hostel/mess), seen as high relative to a temporary, third-party campus setup.
General student consensus reported as negative regarding mess food quality in some reviews, despite other reviews calling it hygienic — indicating inconsistency.
Placements rated only 3.2/5 overall; non-CS branches reportedly see lower packages (~6-7 LPA), and one reference notes an average package as low as 6 LPA with 70% placement in an earlier batch.
Operating out of a third-party building with off-campus hostels limits club activity and overall campus culture compared to institutes with dedicated campuses.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: The next giant IIIT Kalyani — no permanent campus yet, classes at WEBEL IT Park, but AC classrooms; 92% on-campus placement, average 10.22 LPA
The Institute has decent infrastructure, classrooms average in size with ACs and projectors; general consensus negative for mess services
The college is good — good facilities, digital boards, projectors, hygienic food in hostel mess
IIIT Kalyani has average package of around 6 lakh with 70% students placed
Fees of IIITs are very high compared to government medical colleges and local private colleges

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Kalyani is moderately positive, with reasonably strong CSE-specific placement results and decent classroom infrastructure offsetting significant concerns. The clearest weak points are value for money and the institute's continued lack of a permanent campus, echoing a pattern seen across several newer-generation IIITs, along with some inconsistency in mess quality and placement outcomes across branches.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
